expect: category:roses (de) has no human-authored slug in launch locale `de`
why: spec 008 AC-2's first rule: a category with no routed slug in a launch locale has no category page, no country category page and no hub there, silently, because `slugFor()` answering `undefined` is routine in the route. The German roses row is turned back into a machine draft, whose slug never routes (§13 Q10; `src/modules/catalog/slugs.ts`).
